text: A barista was grinding coffee on Rynok Square. My friend stretched his neck clear over the railing for a sniff. For a moment I forgot what brought us to Lviv. I’d like those people to get to finish their coffee.
Remember where that coffee shop is. There are fifty aircraft on their way to Lviv. It’s a long wave, so keep an eye on his health.
Understood. Coffee after landing. No fire in his cup. The barista asked specifically.
